physical_report: A/B/X/Y, triggers and grips seem non-functional in the AR menu after the previous repair.
confirmed_code_gaps: The old neutral check considered unused extra controller slots.
Old menu mappings omitted X and both grips.
Native select events had no per-button sampled menu fallback.
An uncaptured select event could suppress the ordinary gameplay trigger.
repair: Session-owned per-source menu edges; A/X confirm, B/Y one-level back, both triggers select, grips previous/next, both sticks navigation/adjustment. Passive values do not hold readiness. Native/polled triggers share a latch. Fresh ray movement restores aiming; activation uses displayed targets. Buttons take priority over concurrent navigation and held sticks require individual release after system interruption. Uncaptured triggers remain available to gameplay.

acceptance.button_coverage: Actual game and stereo renderer, no assisting Xbox, hidden/unfocused HTML, getter-backed twelve-slot XR pads and active unused sensor values. All four face buttons, both grips, both raw triggers without select events, late-event deduplication, visible-cursor navigation, no-ray grip/A activation, held B, both sticks, nested menus, direct resume, both gameplay trigger inputs/releases, changed head poses, system visibility, hands and XR exit.
acceptance.regression_coverage: Modern Workshop text/undo/pan/playtest-return and session switching; Portal Network; twelve actual mailbox deliveries and a first-attempt finish. Protected persistent fixtures and all eight campaign builders remain unchanged. Full delivery movement uses supported 2D after real 3D inspection.
acceptance.limitations: Emulated controllers, head poses and HTML visibility are not physical Quest or Xbox approval. Real passthrough, hardware ergonomics, readability, performance and long sessions remain untested. Passing the declared journeys does not prove every imported document or complete XR chapter. The failed delivery attempt remains evidence that this automation is timing-sensitive.

retained_failures.scope: A detected after grip navigation but selected an old target instead of the pointed Sound menu.
retained_failures.correction: Track accumulated ray-pose movement and keep activation bound to displayed controls.

retained_failures.scope: After passing the face/grip/trigger checks, the old stick oracle measured hidden DOM focus instead of the visible virtual footer selection.
retained_failures.correction: Require a changed currently displayed headset selection for both sticks and additionally prove grip navigation plus A opens the real Sound menu with both rays away.

retained_failures.scope: Superseded by the final simultaneous-input priority correction; cancelled jobs do not establish acceptance.
After nine real deliveries and one attempt, the Gallery Gate forward-window observer timed out. No page/console error was recorded.
retained_failures.recovery: Reran only the failed job after the run finished, without changing source, test, physics or player state. Attempt 2 passed all 53 checks and twelve real deliveries on the same source. This is a retained timing-sensitive test failure, not a claim of universal delivery attainability.

retained_failures.scope: Temporary integration placeholder intentionally stopped before runtime writes; replaced by source-bound readable integration and removed from final tree.
Local browser navigation was blocked by administrator policy. Local Node tests are separate from hosted real-browser evidence.

readiness_reproduction.description: Both hands with seven and twelve button slots, only unused slots active: actual old readiness false, repaired readiness true. An actual held trigger still blocks readiness. Isolated function execution, not proof of the user's physical profile.
